We are modernizing a large, business-critical operational platform that has evolved over many years and combines application logic, database-level rules, and partly manual operational processes. The project involves transitioning the existing solution towards a modern, cloud-native architecture , delivered by a small senior team working with heavy AI leverage.
As a Senior Java Developer , you will join the team at the moment when requirements and target architecture are in place and the build starts. This is a hands-on implementation role - the large majority of your time goes into writing, testing, and shipping production code, not into high-level design or governance.
Here is what the project involves:

• Re-implementing legacy logic. Working through existing Java/Spring code, Oracle schemas, and PL/SQL, extracting the business rules that actually run the operation, and rebuilding them as clean, well-tested Spring Boot services.

• Building the new platform on Azure. Implementing services, integrations, and APIs on Azure with PostgreSQL as the operational database and Databricks for analytics and reporting data.

• Migrating without stopping operations. Moving data and functionality from Oracle to the new stack in a way that supports parallel run, reconciliation, and a safe cutover for a system that cannot go down.

🚀 Your main responsibilities:

• Design and implement backend services in Java and Spring Boot, from domain model and business logic through persistence and API layers.

• Analyze legacy Java/Spring code and Oracle PL/SQL, and re-implement business logic in the new services, with tests that prove behavioural parity.

• Build the PostgreSQL data layer: schema design, JPA/Hibernate mappings, versioned migrations (Flyway / Liquibase), and query performance tuning.

• Implement Oracle → PostgreSQL data migration and reconciliation tooling to support parallel run and cutover.

• Develop REST APIs (contract-first, OpenAPI) consumed by operational portals and integrated systems.

• Implement asynchronous integrations and event flows (e.g. Azure Service Bus, Kafka), including retries, idempotency, and error handling.

• Deliver data feeds from the operational platform into Databricks in cooperation with data engineers.

• Write automated tests at every level (JUnit, integration tests with Testcontainers, contract tests) and keep the codebase production-ready.

• Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and deployment to Azure across DEV / TEST / PROD environments.

• Build in logging, monitoring, and alerting so the system can be run 24/7; take part in troubleshooting and production readiness ahead of go-live.

• Work closely with the Business Analyst / Product Owner on user stories and acceptance criteria, and do code reviews within the team.
